subject: general
question:
**Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.**

Atmospheric rivers are long, narrow bands of moisture in the atmosphere that extends from the tropics to higher latitudes.

options.text: Atmospheric rivers are long, narrow bands
of moisture in the atmosphere that extends from the

solution:
Here the correct answer is** Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error is in the following **part **of the sentence: **"extends"** should be changed to **"extend"** to agree with the plural subject** "bands."**
 
• The correct sentence would be:* "Atmospheric rivers are long, narrow bands **of moisture in the atmosphere that extend from the**__ tropics to higher latitudes."* 
 
• This is an example of subject-verb agreement, where the verb must agree in number with the subject.
 
• In this case, "**bands**" is plural, so the verb "**extend**" must also be plural.
